title: 1465 Fez revolt
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1465 Fez revolt", at revision 1366193321, opens: "The 1465 Fez revolt was a popular uprising in the Marinid capital of Fez against Sultan Abd al-Haqq II, the final ruler of the Marinid dynasty, and his Jewish vizier, Harun ibn Batash." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3411960, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "uprising and end of the Marinid dynasty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
